title: The impact of nanomaterials on plant health: a review of exposure, toxicity, and control
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00037H, Critical Review
Taiming Zhang, Quanlong Wang, Yukui Rui
With the increasing application of nanotechnology, nanomaterials (NMs), especially metals or metal oxides, inevitably enter various environmental media and then enter into plants.
